summary: Both new tests are load-bearing and value-based. Canvas staleness-guard test (FunnelCanvas.spec.ts:343-374): selects sA at index 0, shifts array so index 0 now holds sB, submits stale sA edit, then asserts both update:steps and step-save are NOT emitted — removing the guard's early-return causes update:steps to fire, so the test fails as required. Page feedback-clear test (funnel-editor.spec.ts:392-426): two-phase sequence raises the banner via an incomplete save (asserts banner exists + update not called), then drives a completed save and asserts storeMock.update called exactly once with body.steps[0].blocks[0].text === 'Привіт' AND the feedback element is absent — removing the feedback-null assignment leaves the element rendered, so the test fails. Round-1 gap (untested feedback-clear-on-success branch) is closed. No existing assertions were weakened. No findings.
